premises: Thermal annealing of HfNbTaTiZr between 600–1200 K induces measurable short-range chemical ordering (SRCO).
SRCO creates heterogeneous energy barriers that impede dislocation motion.
SRCO modifies interatomic bond stiffness, increasing elastic moduli.
SRCO reduces lattice vibrational freedom, lowering thermal expansion.
